### 🟡 Changes recommended Unresolved correctness issues remain in state handling and notification ordering.
1 open finding - [Error responses are treated as empty results](#discussion_r6100) · New
What changed in this PR Adds staged state handling and notifications. | File | Summary | Review notes | |---|---|---| | `src/​app/​state.py` | Adds state validation and persistence. | **Moderate (1):** Validation permits an impossible reopened timeline. | | `src/​app/​notify.py` | Adds notifications. | **Moderate (1):** Same-second observations can be mislabeled as recurring.
**Moderate (1):** Concurrent new items can both notify before persistence. | | `src/​app/​routines.md` | Defines the guarded routine. | **Nit (1):** Credential bootstrap writes outside the stated read-only path. | | `README.md` | Documents new commands. | — |
🧠 **Review effort:** Lite
